overview:
**Fire danger remains Moderate today, driven mainly by very low minimum humidity (24%), which trips one of the area's seven watchout thresholds.**

- The 7-day outlook holds steady at Moderate through September 26, with ERC creeping up from 57% to 66% as fuels slowly dry.
- Weather driver: sunny, breezy conditions today (winds 13 mph) give way to cooler air and light rain chances midweek (up to 0.10" on the 24th), which should ease fire potential slightly.
- No Red Flag Warning is in effect; only 1 of 7 local watchout thresholds (low min RH) is currently met.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM lands in Montrose, San Miguel, Ouray, Delta and part of Gunnison County, while the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests removed all fire restrictions effective September 3, 2026.
- Nearby: the Elk Fire near Lake City, CO is 7,257 acres and listed at 73% contained in today's sit report, with minimal ongoing activity.
